interface_name.description: Network interface on which to advertise router advertisements (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0').

send_advertisements.description: Enable or disable sending of router advertisements on this interface.

min_interval.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between unsolicited router advertisements.

max_interval.description: Maximum time (in seconds) between router advertisements. If omitted, defaults to min_interval.

hop_limit.description: Default hop limit for packets (typically 64 or 255).

prefixes.description: List of IPv6 prefixes to advertise on this interface.

valid_lifetime.description: How long (in seconds) the prefix is valid for address configuration.

preferred_lifetime.description: How long (in seconds) the prefix is preferred for new address assignments.

onlink.description: Indicates whether the prefix is on-link (reachable directly).

autonomous.description: Enable stateless address autoconfiguration (SLAAC) using this prefix.

router_address.description: Include the router's address as the source address in the prefix (rarely needed).

route_descriptors.description: List of route information (RFC 4191) to advertise.

prefix_length.description: Length of the route prefix mask (typically 64).

router_address.description: Include the router's own address as a next-hop hint.

rdnss_list.description: List of recursive DNS servers (RDNSS) to advertise.

address.description: IPv6 address of a DNS server.

lifetime.description: Lifetime (in seconds) for the RDNSS entry.

dnssl_list.description: List of DNS search domains (DNSSL) to advertise.

lifetime.description: Lifetime (in seconds) for the DNSSL entry.

managed_config.description: Set Managed Address Configuration flag (indicating DHCPv6 is available for addresses).

other_config.description: Set Other Configuration flag (indicating DHCPv6 is available for non-address info, e.g., DNS).

link_mtu.description: Advertised link MTU (if not automatically derived from interface).
